name: Confluence
description: Search Confluence from Orca's sidebar, open pages as read-only Markdown tabs, and copy [Exact title](url) links. Data Center, Server and Cloud.

settings.title: Base URL
settings.description: Your Confluence address: https://confluence.example.com for Data Center or Server, https://your-site.atlassian.net/wiki for Cloud.

settings.title: Sign-in
settings.description: How the token in the panel's Connection is sent.

settings.title: Atlassian e-mail (Cloud only)
settings.description: The account e-mail that goes with a Cloud API token. Leave empty for Data Center.

settings.title: Spaces
settings.description: Space keys for the panel's space picker, separated by commas, e.g. DOC, TEAM.

settings.title: Link style
settings.description: The address Copy link and the page copies use.
enumLabels: The URL Confluence shows (pretty, changes with the title)
